Market today:
The mood for tech and AI is mixed. While some strategists are buying the dip, recent AI IPOs have flopped, and US-China AI tensions are rising. Lower Treasury yields offer a slight tailwind for growth stocks.

Your holdings:
Several positions need immediate attention due to blown stops and significant losses, amplified by margin. SOXL (-56.11%), MUU (-30.63%), SPAL (-35.9%), and SMCI (-26.85%) are particularly concerning, as their stops are already breached. SMH (-13.82%) is also on a TRIM status and near its stop.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on AI sentiment, which is currently very volatile. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs for further decay and ensure stops are respected.

Bottom line:
With significant losses in leveraged positions and blown stops, risk management is paramount right now.
plays: SOXL, MUU, SPAL, and SMCI have blown past their stops. Given your margin, consider exiting these leveraged and high-loss positions immediately to prevent further drawdown.
For SMH, which is on TRIM status and near its stop at 540, consider reducing your position if it breaks that level.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market is too volatile, and your portfolio needs risk management first.
